_comment: Mutation spec for the bots-app simulcast-cap coupling, run by
The coupling under test: the entrypoint default and BOTH k8s manifests must agree
on BOT_HW_CONCURRENCY, and the value must be exactly 10 (the client's >=10 -> 3-rung
threshold). The 10 -> 100 case is here because a substring assertion
The asserted value and the committed_claims below landed in PR #2252 (issue #2248).

mutations.name: entrypoint default 10 -> 6 (two rungs)
expect_kills: defaults the simulcast cap to 3 rungs

mutations.name: entrypoint default 10 -> 100 (substring hole)
expect_kills: defaults the simulcast cap to 3 rungs

mutations.name: statefulset drifts from the entrypoint default
expect_kills: defaults the simulcast cap to 3 rungs

mutations.name: bot-pod drifts from the entrypoint default
expect_kills: defaults the simulcast cap to 3 rungs
